mapper.sql: landed_costs.id AS id, landed_costs.code AS code, landed_costs.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, landed_costs.date AS `date`, landed_costs.vendor_id AS paidToId, paidTo.name AS paidToName, landed_costs.landed_cost_type_id AS landedCostTypeId, landed_cost_types.name AS landedCostTypeName, landed_costs.reference AS reference, landed_costs.supply_id AS supplyId, supply.name AS supplyName, landed_costs.ap_id AS apId, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, ' ', chart_accounts.account_description) AS apName, landed_costs.note AS note, landed_costs.total_amount AS totalAmount, landed_costs.balance AS balance, landed_costs.status AS status, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, landed_costs.created AS created, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy, landed_costs.modified AS modified

FROM landed_costs INNER JOIN companies ON landed_costs.company_id = companies.id LEFT JOIN vendors AS paidTo ON landed_costs.vendor_id = paidTo.id LEFT JOIN vendors AS supply ON landed_costs.vendor_id = supply.id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = landed_costs.currency_center_id INNER JOIN landed_cost_types ON landed_costs.landed_cost_type_id = landed_cost_types.id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON landed_costs.ap_id = chart_accounts.id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = landed_costs.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = landed_costs.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO landed_costs ( company_id, `date`, code, vendor_id, currency_center_id, landed_cost_type_id, reference, supply_id, ap_id, note, total_amount, balance, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{landedCost.companyId}, #{landedCost.date}, #{landedCost.code}, #{landedCost.vendorId}, (SELECT currency_center_id FROM companies WHERE id = #{landedCost.companyId}), #{landedCost.landedCostTypeId}, #{landedCost.reference}, #{landedCost.supplyId}, #{landedCost.apId}, #{landedCost.note}, #{landedCost.totalAmount}, #{landedCost.totalAmount}, NOW(), #{landedCost.createdBy}, #{landedCost.status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE general_ledgers SET is_active = 2 WHERE landed_cost_id = #{landedCostId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO general_ledgers ( landed_cost_id, `date`, reference, created, created_by, is_sys ) VALUES ( #{generalLedger.landedCostId}, #{generalLedger.date}, #{generalLedger.reference}, NOW(), #{generalLedger.createdBy}, #{generalLedger.isSys} )

INSERT INTO general_ledger_details ( general_ledger_id, chart_account_id, company_id, location_id, product_id, type, debit, credit, memo, vendor_id ) VALUES ( #{generalLedgerDetail.generalLedgerId}, #{generalLedgerDetail.chartAccountId}, #{generalLedgerDetail.companyId}, #{generalLedgerDetail.locationId}, #{generalLedgerDetail.productId},
#{generalLedgerDetail.type}, #{generalLedgerDetail.debit}, #{generalLedgerDetail.credit}, #{generalLedgerDetail.memo}, #{generalLedgerDetail.vendorId} )
mapper.select: ( SELECT 1 AS `type`, (SELECT purchase_order_id FROM purchase_order_details WHERE purchase_order_details.id = landed_cost_details.purchase_order_detail_id) AS purchaseBillId, landed_cost_details.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseBillDetailId, landed_cost_details.id AS id, landed_cost_details.product_id AS itemId, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, landed_cost_details.qty AS qty, landed_cost_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, landed_cost_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, landed_cost_details.landed_cost AS landedCost, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom,1) / IFNULL(landed_cost_details.conversion,1) AS conversion, landed_cost_details.small_val_uom AS smallValUom FROM landed_cost_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = landed_cost_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = landed_cost_details.qty_uom_id WHERE landed_cost_details.landed_cost_id = #{id} ) UNION ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, NULL AS purchaseBillId, NULL AS purchaseBillDetailId, landed_cost_services.id AS id, landed_cost_services.service_id AS itemId, services.name AS itemName, services.sku AS sku, NULL AS upc, landed_cost_services.qty AS qty, NULL AS uomId, NULL AS uomName, landed_cost_services.unit_cost AS unitCost, landed_cost_services.landed_cost AS landedCost, landed_cost_services.conversion AS conversion, landed_cost_services.small_val_uom AS smallValUom FROM landed_cost_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = landed_cost_services.service_id WHERE landed_cost_services.landed_cost_id = #{id} ) ORDER BY `type` DESC, id ASC

SELECT (SELECT purchase_order_id FROM purchase_order_details WHERE purchase_order_details.id = landed_cost_details.purchase_order_detail_id) AS purchaseBillId, landed_cost_details.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseBillDetailId, landed_cost_details.id AS id, landed_cost_details.product_id AS itemId, products.name AS itemName, products.small_val_uom AS smallValUom, landed_cost_details.qty AS qty, landed_cost_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, landed_cost_details.landed_cost AS landedCost, landed_cost_details.conversion AS conversion FROM landed_cost_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = landed_cost_details.product_id WHERE landed_cost_details.landed_cost_id = #{id}

SELECT landed_cost_purchase_orders.purchase_order_id AS id, purchase_orders.po_code AS code FROM landed_cost_purchase_orders LEFT JOIN purchase_orders ON purchase_orders.id = landed_cost_purchase_orders.purchase_order_id WHERE landed_cost_purchase_orders.landed_cost_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO landed_cost_details ( landed_cost_id, purchase_order_detail_id, product_id, qty, qty_uom_id, conversion, small_val_uom, unit_cost, landed_cost ) VALUES ( #{landedCostDetail.landedCostId}, #{landedCostDetail.purchaseBillDetailId}, #{landedCostDetail.productId}, #{landedCostDetail.qty}, #{landedCostDetail.uomId}, #{landedCostDetail.conversion}, #{landedCostDetail.smallValUom}, #{landedCostDetail.unitCost}, #{landedCostDetail.landedCost} );

INSERT INTO landed_cost_services ( landed_cost_id, service_id, qty, qty_uom_id, conversion, small_val_uom, unit_cost, landed_cost ) VALUES ( #{landedCostServices.landedCostId}, #{landedCostServices.serviceId}, #{landedCostServices.qty}, #{landedCostServices.uomId}, #{landedCostServices.conversion}, #{landedCostServices.smallValUom}, #{landedCostServices.unitCost}, #{landedCostServices.landedCost} );

INSERT INTO landed_costs ( company_id, `code`, date, vendor_id, currency_center_id, landed_cost_type_id, reference, supply_id, ap_id, note, total_amount, balance, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{landedCost.companyId}, #{landedCost.code}, #{landedCost.date}, #{landedCost.vendorId}, (SELECT currency_center_id FROM companies WHERE id = #{landedCost.companyId}), #{landedCost.landedCostTypeId}, #{landedCost.reference}, #{landedCost.supplyId}, #{landedCost.apId}, #{landedCost.note}, #{landedCost.totalAmount}, #{landedCost.totalAmount}, NOW(), #{landedCost.modifiedBy}, #{landedCost.status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE landed_costs SET status = -1, edited = NOW(), edited_by = #{userId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id};
